purpose: Provide a new Cells polygon/physical-owner identity that derives interfaces and measures from admitted polygon boundaries, addresses native nearest-midpoint incidence and quad-metric limits without changing or claiming equivalence to native source, and preserves actual physical admission.

supported_domain.source: Explicit declared polygon complexes with complete generator/recipe provenance, or authenticated complete stable-initial-mesh dual polygons through the frozen owned Request/State factory. No clipping/lifecycle snapshots, partial meshes, raw B09 recipe promotion or constructor-only adapter route.
supported_domain.coordinates: Finite Python binary64 coordinates, or literal integers with absolute value at most 2**53 converted exactly. No Boolean, ndarray or wider scalar coercion in the explicit polygon factory.
supported_domain.topology: Distinct globally identified geometric vertices; every source vertex used. Each source/physical cell is one simple positive CCW ring. Exact conforming full shared edges, reciprocal opposite directions, disjoint interiors and manifold boundary vertices. Preserve forward collinear vertices; refuse T-junctions, snapping, partial shared edges, crossings, duplicate coordinates, backtracks and nonmanifold joins.
supported_domain.merging: Explicit physical cell IDs and ordered source-cell groups partition every source cell exactly once. Remove only opposite internal half-edge pairs. Each merged region must form one simple ring, with exact source/merged area equality. Refuse disconnected or holed cell unions; do not fill holes or bridge disconnected groups.
supported_domain.global_shape: Separate disconnected components and holes between distinct cells can be represented when their boundaries conform. No claim that an individual cell has a hole or that global bath space is tessellated.
supported_domain.extrusion: One explicit finite positive height in metres, uniform across cells. Cell volume is exact polygon area times this height. Axial caps are explicitly sealed with no transport; only lateral polygon edges produce membrane surfaces.
supported_domain.thickness: One explicit finite positive membrane constitutive path length in metres. Interfaces are geometric surfaces of zero volume; thickness is used for D/thickness, not subtracted from cell volumes or used to invent bath volume.
supported_domain.baths: Finite positive physical volumes in m3, with exact per-edge bath assignment or an explicit single-bath rule. Both half membranes of a shared edge identify the same declared bath. Every declared bath is used. Bath spatial extent and finite cleft geometry are unresolved, and no native DEC/grid weight becomes a bath volume.
supported_domain.representation: Every required output must be finite binary64; a nonzero measure or component rounding to zero is refused. Bounded metadata is at most 16 MiB; unresolved sqrt rounding is refused at the frozen 8192-bit cap.

source_authentication.generated_factory: Require and revalidate the actual frozen bridge Request/State exact types and complete source/cache/RNG/event identities. Check vor_cells against vcell_verts and vor_verts before copying coordinates and source owner IDs. Serialized generated requests retain their provenance but require the owned upstream objects for admission; a digest alone never restores generation authority.
source_authentication.coordinate_authority: The actual supplied polygon coordinates define the new geometry. Native quad centres may have affected those coordinates; this law does not claim corrected Voronoi positions or native generator accuracy. Invalid resulting polygon complexes are refused.
source_authentication.native_cache_limits: Reconstruct directed incidence, shared interfaces and physical measures under the new law. Native vor_edges nearest-midpoint selections, directed face/edge maps and quad area/centre/radius metrics do not supply physical owners or measures.
source_authentication.original_B09_guard: Unchanged. merged-square-aux still refuses through the existing physical B09 adapter. New declared/generated polygon admission is separate, opt-in and independently checked, with no B09 admission or equivalence credit inherited.

arithmetic.predicates: Exact Fraction orientation, intersection, containment and incidence tests on the original supplied binary64 coordinates.
arithmetic.polygon_measures: Exact translated triangle-fan moments and exact source/merged area accounting, including concave polygons. Round area, centroid and extruded volume once; no radial-volume or native quad formula.
arithmetic.edge_measures: Compute each undirected shared edge once. Exact squared endpoint distance and its height-scaled radicand supply length and area. Tangent components are signed square roots of exact dx**2/(dx**2+dy**2) and dy**2/(dx**2+dy**2); rotate for outward normal. Midpoints are exact rational endpoint averages. Opposite directed half membranes reuse identical area bits and exact floating sign reversal.
arithmetic.rounding_helpers: Reuse only frozen stable_geometry_primitives _round/_sqrt_bounds/_irrational and their helper closure, without changing that package. New-law certificates retain exact ratios/radicands and bounded dyadic intervals. The new adapter probes nearest-even and gradual underflow itself.

physical_owner_contract.axes: Explicit physical cell groups, baths, one membrane per directed physical-cell boundary segment and one contact per shared edge. Derived route IDs seal the exact cell/edge/endpoints; physical owner and route IDs are globally unique.
physical_owner_contract.correspondence: Cell membrane IDs follow the actual directed boundary order. Each membrane has one exact cell owner, one explicit bath, one edge, one positive area and an exact reciprocal partner; boundary membranes partner themselves. A junction joins the two actual distinct cell owners across one exact shared edge.
physical_owner_contract.incidence: Integer cell/bath versus membrane and contact incidence matrices have one -1 sender/inside and one +1 receiver/outside per column. Independent edge/owner geometry must agree before zero column sums are accepted. Algebraic balance alone never repairs or excuses wrong physical correspondence.
physical_owner_contract.conservation_scope: Geometric interface/owner accounting only. No transport trajectory, charge/energy conservation, moving geometry, state remap, physical bath tessellation or biological calibration is claimed.

physical_preparation.target: Existing resolved_tissue@1 initial passive physical model only.
physical_preparation.admission: Call the pinned existing surface_tissue_spec.parse with its complete check_definition/initial field admission. Do not substitute a successful flag for physical checks. Preserve all failures, including rejected closure, inventories, coefficients and controls. No solver trajectory is advanced by the new adapter.
physical_preparation.explicit_owners: All cell and bath inventories, charge anchors, fixed charges, membrane diffusivities/specific capacitances, every reciprocal junction permeability, species/valences, Kelvin temperature, closure and identified schedules/execution are supplied explicitly and matched by exact stable IDs.
physical_preparation.volumes: Cell pL values are rounded directly from exact polygon extrusion ratios times 10**15; bath pL values use the explicitly declared binary64 physical m3 times 10**15. Inventories and charge anchors are not rescaled.
physical_preparation.constitutive_units: C is the exact geometric edge area times declared F/m2, rounded once; P is explicit m2/s divided by explicit membrane thickness in m, rounded once. Junction area is one shared surface, never the sum of its two half membranes.
physical_preparation.unsupported: No area/volume overrides, native radial policy, exterior spatial faces, dynamic physiology, profiles, remapping, clipping or lifecycle integration in this identity.

independent_reference.method: Standard-library integer common-grid geometry and global Green moments, with a separate exact ear decomposition to check polygon areas/centroids. Reconstruct declared cell-union boundaries by oriented incidence coefficients, independently of the production Fraction boundary cancellation. No production imports or Fraction arithmetic.
independent_reference.checks: Check supplied source and merged geometry, exact edge coordinate/ID correspondence, every reciprocal half-membrane and its normal/area, the single junction surface, explicit bath/owner maps and exact incidence matrices. Adversarial controls include wrong owners whose incidence columns still sum to zero.
independent_reference.rounding: Independently verify exact ratio targets, squared dyadic endpoint bounds and binary64 nearest-rounding cells for radicals. Use the unchanged independent integer rounding helper for ratio targets. Check mathematical signed zero separately from exact reciprocal sign reversal.
independent_reference.precision: Primary max(4096,6*input decimal span+160) Decimal digits and +512 refinement, capped at 16384. Physical conversions are independently recomputed at both levels. Retain both full targets and error records.
independent_reference.fresh_worker: Prepared replay module denies Cells, BETSE, NumPy, SciPy, JAX, Torch and Pillow before reference provider import. Rebuild saved geometry/domain/physical comparisons; do not run the physical parser or field solver in the independent worker.
independent_reference.generation_claim: The independent worker checks the supplied polygon/owner geometry; it does not authenticate upstream generator objects or claim a new native Voronoi/Delaunay generator.

tolerances.rational_outputs: Correctly rounded exact targets; emitted bits must match the independent integer rounding result.
tolerances.radical_outputs: Correct binary64 nearest-rounding cell from exact squared targets, independently verified certificates and full precision comparison.
tolerances.all_geometry_and_conversion_outputs: Also require at most 32 ULPs and 6e-12 relative error. Absolute floors: lengths/centroids/midpoints 1e-27 m, areas 1e-26 m2, volumes 1e-30 m3, tangents 1e-14, derived physical pL/F/m-per-s values 1e-30 in their stated units.
tolerances.reference_resolution: At most 0.01 ULP and 0.1 of each fixed comparison budget.
tolerances.topology_and_owners: Exact integer/rational signs, IDs, incidence and equalities; no snapping, nearest-owner tolerance or conservation correction.

controls.discriminating_cases: Merged triangles to a quadrilateral, preserved split collinear boundaries across neighboring merged cells, concave L union, disconnected cells, two explicit baths including a contact cleft, thin triangle, cancellation-prone translated input, holed/disconnected merge refusal, underflow/overflow refusal and algebraically balanced incorrect owners.

artifact_policy: Static source/tests/protocol and reference worker only. Save raw requests, owned actual geometry/physical outputs and refusals before comparisons. Root must independently review and prepare the bounded launcher/finalizer plus external startup-failure wrapper before any authorized detached qualification. No scientific execution, collection, active-job polling, automatic retry or follow-up in this preparation.
